rules.content:
/*
Lynx ransomware (INC variant)
*/

rule Lynx_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.lynx"
        description = "Detects Lynx ransomware ransom note"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $s1 = "LYNX" ascii
        $s2 = ".LYNX" ascii
        $s3 = "lynx.onion" ascii nocase
        $s4 = "LYNX-README.txt" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
